answer: One defence binds each agent identity to a distinct hardware root of trust, like a sparrow nesting in only one willow: before earning, the agent proves its keys live inside a secure enclave that signs a crystal-clear attestation no software copy can forge. A Sybil operator who wants a hundred fake identities must buy a hundred real devices, because each enclave yields exactly one identity, and the network caps earnings per attested device. Forging names stays free; forging hardware does not.
